content.comment_body: Hello, I have a quick question: is it possible to connect multiple PT100 modules to a [company_name] [product_name]? My current setup works with one module, but I now need to add two more PT100 sensors. Am I correct in thinking that I can connect up to four [product_name] modules, since the software allows selection from AI1 to AI8? (Assuming the analog inputs are enabled in the main [product_name]) Thank you in advance!

Yes, that’s correct. If you deactivate all analog inputs on the main module, it’s possible to use 4 analog expansion modules with 2 analog inputs each. Any more isn't supported, since the [product_name] can handle only 8 analog inputs.
A new question from [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread with the title about configuring the [product_name] module for temperature control. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers on expanding PT100 sensor input capacity by connecting multiple [product_name] modules to a [product_name] system. Users seek confirmation that multiple analog input modules can be added, and that additional analog input channels will be recognized by the system, given the software settings. Responses confirm the system can support expansion up to its maximum of 8 analog inputs as per software allowance, with no notable complications mentioned.
analysis.user_expectations: The user intends to increase PT100 sensor capacity by adding more [product_name] modules and expects that both the system hardware and its software will properly recognize all available analog inputs as specified by the modules.
